data.body: Scope validation against the approved remediation: MATCH. The story is limited to plan-review evidence classification. It blocks operator-attested tags only when affirmative repository evidence proves the criterion is codebase-verifiable; it preserves genuine execution/live-state outcomes (test run, deployment, DB mutation) even when related implementation code exists; mixed evidence requires splitting; exact ADR-0043 tag semantics remain unchanged; and the completion verifier trust boundary is explicitly out of scope. The symmetric malformed/missing-tag cases and pinned frozen-corpus thresholds are part of the approved classification contract, not scope expansion.
